idea-plugin.name: CanFx Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Code generation for solutions created with the CanFx template. Right-click → CanFx:

  • Add → CanFx Entity (Domain project): only the name is asked; the base class options (Entity, AuditedEntity, FullAuditedEntity, AggregateRoot ...) and the fields they add are listed in the file.
  • Generate CRUD (entity): commands, queries, validators, responses, rules, permissions, EF configuration, endpoints.
  • Add Seed Data (entity): required data from JSON in every environment, sample data in Development, HasData.
  • Mechanisms (request, entity or feature folder): turn caching, logging, transaction, secured operation or dynamic query on or off later.
  • Rate Limit (request or controller action): bind a rate limit policy; missing policies are added to appsettings.
  • Features (anywhere in the solution): add or remove Redis, search, event bus, Hangfire, file storage, SignalR, SMS, OpenTelemetry, Postman sync.

Every change to existing files is shown as a diff before it is applied. Places that need your input are marked with TODO(canfxgen).

The code is generated by the canfxgen command line tool, which this plugin calls: dotnet tool install -g CanFx.Generator

Source code: github.com/oguzhan-c/Generator (MIT)

Türkçe: CanFx şablonuyla oluşturulmuş çözümlerde sağ tık → CanFx: entity, CRUD, seed, mekanizmalar, hız sınırı ve özellikler. Kodu canfxgen aracı üretir; eklenti onu çağırır, değişiklikleri önce gösterir.

action.description: Creates an entity in the Domain project (canfxgen generate entity)
Generates CRUD code for the selected entity (canfxgen crud)
Required (JSON) and Development sample data for the entity (canfxgen generate seeder)
Turns caching, logging, transaction, secured operation or dynamic query on or off, with preview
Binds a rate limit policy to an endpoint, with preview (canfxgen rate-limit)
Adds or removes template features (Redis, search, event bus ...), with preview
